description.narrative:
The support is to establish “The Kalavai Partnership” (2024-2025) whereas IPPF partnered with the International Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex Association (ILGA-World), the Association for Women's Rights in Development (AWID), the Global Philanthropy Project (GPP) and Funders Concerned About AIDS (FCAA) to change the game of the collective opposition to SRHR, LGBT+ and gender equality, as well as to collaborate locally since they share exposure and risk in the growing anti-democratic environment. Through the partnership, specific activities are planned in the following common areas: Political Moments, Communications and Campaigns, Security, Fundraising, Investment, Opposition Work, Consultations, Engaging business organizations, Political relations/engagement and Core Partnership work and the ‘Operations Room’.
Goals of the Kalavai Partnership: 1.Powerful, visible moments where political and business leaders stand together with the LGBTQI+, SRHR justice, HIV, and gender equality movement actors, providing strength and hope. 2.Activation and maintenance of an ‘operations room’ where we work towards building political events while building cross-movement trust, long-term bridges, and shared strategies. 3.Collectively mobilized and pooled financial resources to aid the response to global assaults on rights and create synergy rather than competition. Grants and cross-sectoral support provided to national, regional and grassroot LGBTQI+ organizations, ensuring they can work on the better environment created through cross-movement collaboration. 4.Research, continued monitoring and analysis of trends, actions and actors that contribute towards opposition to LGBTQI+ and gender rights and justice. 5.Communications and unified rights-based story-making frameworks that organizations across the sectors adapt and win hearts and minds. 6.More agile access to and use of information, intelligence, and critical strategies
